hackathons.title: TechnoXian
hackathons.eligibility: Junior (up to 16 yrs) and Open categories
hackathons.summary: TechnoXian is a zonal line-follower robotics competition designed to test sensor calibration, IR arrays, and motor PID algorithms under real track conditions. The event features both Junior and Open categories for robotics enthusiasts to build and race autonomous hardware.

hackathons.title: 13th Protocol: An AI Hackathon 2026
hackathons.eligibility: Open to computer science students and developers
hackathons.summary: 13th Protocol is an offline AI hackathon hosted at KCCITM in Greater Noida. Participating teams build artificial intelligence solutions over two days to compete for a prize pool of ₹60K.

hackathons.title: AI + Blockchain Global University Autumn Camp Hackathon
hackathons.eligibility: University students worldwide
hackathons.summary: This global student hackathon organized by Quack AI and Imperial College focuses on AI and blockchain innovation. University students worldwide compete to build Web3 and AI projects on the BNB Chain.

hackathons.title: DevNexus 2.0
hackathons.organizer: Event Management Group of Government College of Engineering and Leather Technology (GCELT)
hackathons.location: Government College of Engineering and Leather Technology (GCELT), Kolkata
hackathons.eligibility: Open to students and developers in teams of 2–4 members
hackathons.summary: DevNexus 2.0 is a 24-hour offline coding hackathon aimed at turning creative ideas into innovative software solutions. Participants collaborate in teams to build functional projects within a fast-paced development sprint.

hackathons.title: RISE Hackathon 2026
hackathons.eligibility: Students
hackathons.summary: RISE Hackathon 2026 is an online tech competition organized by The Pupil Saveetha Eco School. Participants build creative tech projects to win from a ₹45,000 prize pool.

hackathons.title: HackIndia Hackathon at KCCITM
hackathons.eligibility: Open to computer science and engineering students
hackathons.summary: This student hackathon hosted at KCCITM Greater Noida invites tech enthusiasts to build software projects. Competitors showcase their ideas and compete for a prize pool of ₹60K.

hackathons.title: HackIndia KCCITM Hackathon
hackathons.eligibility: Open to students and tech enthusiasts
hackathons.summary: This offline hackathon is hosted at KCCITM in Greater Noida as part of the HackIndia event series. Participating student developers work in teams to construct software solutions within two days.

hackathons.title: HCLTech AMPlified Season 2 Cybersecurity Hackathon
hackathons.eligibility: Students graduating in 2028
hackathons.summary: This multi-stage competition challenges students with an aptitude test, CTF assessment, and a project phase focused on cybersecurity. It evaluates participants on technical security skills and practical problem-solving capabilities.

hackathons.title: BUILD 4 ALL
hackathons.eligibility: Students
hackathons.summary: BUILD 4 ALL is an online hackathon encouraging students to develop creative tech projects. Participants compete virtually to build functional software solutions and earn non-monetary recognition.

hackathons.title: SSOIndia Cybersecurity Hackathon and CTF
hackathons.eligibility: Students competing in teams of 2–3 members
hackathons.summary: This multi-stage cybersecurity competition features an online Mini-CTF, bootcamp, online hackathon, and a final onsite CTF challenge. Participants test their technical skills to design secure, privacy-preserving communication systems.

hackathons.title: MNIT Jaipur Student Hackathon 2026
hackathons.eligibility: Students
hackathons.summary: MNIT Jaipur Student Hackathon 2026 is an online student hackathon hosted by MIIC. It aims to encourage young innovators to develop solutions for real-world problems.

hackathons.title: Protocol Zero: Boot | Hack | CTF
hackathons.organizer: ISEA Project, MeitY, Government of India
hackathons.eligibility: Open to students and cybersecurity enthusiasts
hackathons.summary: This national-level cybersecurity programme engages participants in applied cryptography, vulnerability discovery, and practical problem-solving. It features online bootcamps, hackathons, and Capture The Flag challenges to develop practical security solutions.

hackathons.title: Protocol Zero: Boot | Hack | CTF 2026–27
hackathons.eligibility: Undergraduate and Postgraduate students from recognised institutions across India
hackathons.summary: Protocol Zero is a national-level cybersecurity competition featuring bootcamps, online hackathons, and Capture The Flag challenges. Participants get hands-on experience in applied cryptography, identifying vulnerabilities, and developing practical security solutions.

hackathons.title: UGREEN Hackathon 2026
hackathons.eligibility: Open to students and developers
hackathons.summary: The UGREEN Hackathon 2026 is an online technology challenge hosted by America UGREEN Limited. Participants build innovative software solutions to compete for $46,000 in prizes.

hackathons.title: Capture the Flag by DSCI
hackathons.eligibility: Students, Researchers, Security Professionals
hackathons.summary: Data Security Council of India (DSCI) is hosting a Capture the Flag cybersecurity hackathon alongside the Annual Information Security Summit 2026. The competition features nine challenge areas ranging from GenAI to Cryptography.

hackathons.title: DSCI Capture the Flag Hackathon 2026
hackathons.eligibility: Open to students, researchers, and security professionals
hackathons.summary: The DSCI Capture the Flag hackathon features nine challenge areas ranging from GenAI to cryptography. Hosted alongside the Annual Information Security Summit 2026, it aims to recognize and reward top cybersecurity talent in the country.

hackathons.title: DSCI Cybersecurity Hackathon 2026
hackathons.eligibility: Ethical hackers, students, and cybersecurity enthusiasts
hackathons.summary: Hosted alongside the Annual Information Security Summit 2026, this Capture the Flag event challenges participants in multiple cybersecurity disciplines. Competitors solve real-world problems spanning GenAI, digital forensics, cloud security, blockchain, and cryptography.

hackathons.title: QNX Global Hackathon 2026
hackathons.eligibility: Open to students and global developers
hackathons.summary: The QNX Global Hackathon 2026 is a worldwide online competition hosted on Devpost. Developers create cutting-edge software applications to win prizes from a pool exceeding $50,000.

hackathons.title: PayPal AI Hackathon 2026
hackathons.eligibility: Open to students and developers
hackathons.summary: The PayPal AI Hackathon 2026 is an online competition focusing on artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies. Participants build intelligent applications to compete for a $25,000 prize pool.

hackathons.title: HackIndia Originals- FIN//NEXT 2027
hackathons.eligibility: Open to student developers and builders
hackathons.summary: HackIndia Originals- FIN//NEXT 2027 is a virtual developer hackathon focusing on Web3 and fintech systems. Participants collaborate online over several weeks to build decentralized applications.

hackathons.title: Diversion 2k27
hackathons.location: IEM Gurukul Building, EP Block, Sector V, Bidhannagar, Kolkata, West Bengal, India
hackathons.eligibility: Open to students and developers
hackathons.summary: Diversion 2k27 is an offline student hackathon hosted at Institute of Engineering & Management, Kolkata. Participants work in teams across open themes to build functional technological prototypes.

hackathons.title: AWS Hackathon 2027
hackathons.eligibility: Open to Computer Science and engineering students
hackathons.summary: AWS Hackathon 2027 is a global online hackathon hosted by Amazon Web Services. Competitors build cloud-driven software solutions to win prizes exceeding $50,000.

hackathons.title: Amazon Web Services (AWS) Hackathon
hackathons.eligibility: Open to Computer Science and Engineering students
hackathons.summary: An online developer event focusing on cloud-native application development using AWS. Participants construct scalable, cloud-based applications to address complex technical challenges.

hackathons.title: HACKSPRINT 3.0 2027
hackathons.eligibility: Open to student developers and builders
hackathons.summary: HACKSPRINT 3.0 2027 is an offline hackathon hosted at KAHE, Coimbatore under the HackIndia initiative. Participating student teams collaborate to build and present software solutions over a two-day event.

hackathons.title: HackIndia Chennai Overdrive 2027
hackathons.eligibility: Open to student builders and CS undergraduates
hackathons.summary: HackIndia Chennai Overdrive 2027 is an in-person hackathon held at Muthayammal Engineering College. Teams focus on building solutions using AI/ML, Web3, and Generative AI technologies.

hackathons.title: Diversion 2k27
hackathons.location: IEM Gurukul Building, EP Block, Sector V, Bidhannagar, Kolkata, West Bengal, India
hackathons.eligibility: Open to all students
hackathons.summary: Diversion 2k27 is an offline hackathon organized at IEM Kolkata for students to innovate and build solutions across various domains. Participants collaborate over an open theme to prototype impactful software projects.

hackathons.title: Mailam Builds’27
hackathons.eligibility: Open to engineering students and developers
hackathons.summary: Mailam Builds’27 is an offline hackathon conducted at Mailam Engineering College. Student builders work on real-world projects centered around Blockchain, Web3, and AI technologies.
